environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4). Traffic arrives directly to the Flask application on port 8080. No request inspection or filtering is performed at any layer. The application is the sole enforcement point for input validation. SQLite database is local on EBS volume.

config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0
config.database: SQLite on local EBS gp3 volume
